tei:div.tei:p: (āḥ)༄༅// rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgo nas gshin po rjes su 'dzin pa'i cho ga thar lam 'dren pa'i lcags kyu zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ /oṃ swa sti/ bla ma mchog dang dbyer med lhag pa'i lhar// gus pas btud nas lnga pa'i lam bgrod pa'i// lus can ma lus thar lam bgrod pa'i thabs// lho sgo'i cho ga'i lag len bshad kyis nyon// 'dir rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i cho ga dang rjes su 'brel bar gshin po rjes 'dzin bya ba'i tshul la/ spyir rje btsun ma 'di nyid kyi sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor du gshin po dbang bskur ba sogs mi rung mod kyang*/ lho sgo bya bar 'gal ba med cing phan thogs chen po 'byung bas/ de ji ltar bya ba'i tshul la/ sin dkyil gyi lho phyogs su ras dkar la pad+ma 'dab brgyad bris pa'i lte bar 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs brgyad pa/ de'i lte bar nṛ bris pa'am/ yang na de'i steng du gshin po'i gzugs brnyan rdzus skyes kyi tshul thal mo sbyar ba spyi bor gdugs/ g.yas g.yon du dar dpyangs gdan pad+ma yu ba dang bcas pa ste/ bri ma thub na nṛ dang 'og tu tshe 'das kyi ming bri/ yang na rus pa'am/ gos dri ma can bzhag kyang rung*/ kha cig tshe 'das kyi gzugs bri ba rnying ma'i lugs yin zhes smra ba dang*/ yang kha cig shog bur 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad bris pa'i dbus su nṛ bris pa'ang mthong ste/ dang po ni/ ngan song sbyong rgyud las/ gang gzugs brnyan la yang dbang bskur bar byos shig ces gsal bar gsungs pa ma mthong bar zad cing*/ phyi mas ni gdan dang rten gyi khyad par ma phyed par rgya tshom du spyod pa'o// de'i mdun du zhi drag gi sbyangs chas gtor ma gsum/ ting lo gsum/ chang bu gsum rnams dang*/ bzlas pa'i skabs su bye ma'am yungs kar la sngags kyi nus pa bstim pa/ gu gul dang bcas pa bshams/ cho ga'i bdag 'jug cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol// bar brjod nas/

dmigs rten bum chus sbyangs/ gtor ma rnams la'ang chu gtsang gis bran/ dpon slob rnams kyis dmigs pa ma yengs pa'i sgo nas/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes sogs hūm̐ bzhi pa'i sngags kyis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las dkyil 'khor gyi lho phyogs su sbyong stegs pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa khru gang pa/ de'i dbus su 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar nṛ yongs su gyur pa las 'jig rten 'di nas pha rol tu tshe las 'das pa/ che ge mo tshe 'das kyi ming dngos su smos dgos te/ rgyud las/ de yi ming nas smos nas kyang*// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ zhes bya ba phung po khams dang skye mched thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa gson po'i rnam pa ji lta ba bzhin du gyur/ rang gi snying kha'i bam̐ dang tshe 'das kyi snying kha'i nṛ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ tshe 'das kyi rnam par shes pa khams gsum gang na gnas kyang 'dir mchis par gyur cig rdo dril mi dgos hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ sems kyi dmigs pa tshe 'das kyi rnam shes gang na gnas kyang rang dbang med par bkug par bsam la sgrigs 'don byas te/ sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bden pa dang*/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin gyis rlabs kyis dmigs yul tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bya ba'i rnam par shes pa khams gsum skye gnas bzhi rigs drug gang na gnas kyang skad cig gis rten 'di nyid la thim par gyur cig oṃ ṭak+ki hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes lan gsum brjod pas/ nges par rten la thim par bsam/ de nas lag pa rdo rje bsdams pa las gung mo dang mtha' bzhi sgreng ba sdig pa 'bral ba'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ sho dha ni sho dha ni sarba pā paṃ a pa na ye hūm̐/ oṃ sarba bid sarba pā paṃ sho dha ni badz+ra hūm̐ phaṭ/

oṃ sarba bita tra tha/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi bi s+pho ṭa ya/ sarba a pā ya na sha ya/ bhan+dha na pra mo k+ṣa ya/ sarba a pā ya ga ti bh+yaḥ sarba satwa na ma/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra sa ma ya tra tha/ zhes lan gsum brjod dgos te 'di sdig pa bral ba'i gtso bo yin pa'i phyir/ rdo rje bsdams pa dral la/ oṃ badz+ra bhan+dha tra tha/ yang yang brjod/ tshe 'das kyi gnas gsum rdo rje khu tshur gtugs par mos nas phyag rgya dang bcas te/ oṃ sarba bid badz+ra a dhi tiṣ+ṭha dz+nyā na sa ma ye hūm̐ zhes brjod pas/ tshe 'das kyi rnam par shes pa a dkar po dri ma med pa sdig pa sbyong rung gi rnam pa can du gyur par bsams la/ de nas zhi ba'i sbyong ba ni/ gtor ma re re rten la g.yas su bskor zhing*/ oṃ sarba bigh+nan na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yoḥbi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba that+gaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ ghṛ hā+e daṃ ba liṃ ta ye swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis zhi bas sbyangs/ 'di la zhi ba'i sbyang ba zhes brjod de/ rdzas sngags gnyis ka zhi ba yin pa'i phyar ro// de nas ting lo chang bu bcas rten la g.yon du bskor zhing*/ oṃ sum+bha ni sogs lan gsum gyi zhi drag phyed mas sbyangs/ 'di la zhi drag phyed ma'i sbyang ba zhes brjod de/ rdzas zhi ba dang sngags drag po yin pa'i phyir ro// 'jig rten 'di nas pha rol tu tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bgyi ba gson gyi dus tshe gnas pa la bar du gcod cing*/ gshin gyi dus na sdig pa sbyong ba la bar chad byed pa dang*/ slar yang gshin po de nyid kyi cha byad bzung ste nye 'brel dang 'jig rten pa gzhan rnams bslu bar byed pa'i gdon bgegs log par 'dren pa'i tshogs thams cad gtor ma lam brngan ting lo lam sgron/ chang bu lam rgyags kyi tshul du khyer la sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig gang dag mi 'gro ba de dag la de bzhin gshegs pa thamasaca da kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes khro bo'i rdo rje 'bar zhing rab tu 'bar ba 'dis khyed rnams kyi mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par bya'o// zhes brjod cing gu gul gyis bdugs/

rol mo'i sgra drag po dang bcas te gtor ma phyir dor nas rgyas par byed na/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas khro bo me ltar 'bar ba la ye shes kyi khro bo'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ hūm̐/ ye shes bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i 'od// ma rig 'dod pa'i mun khams thams cad bsreg /zhe sdang gshin rje'i 'jigs pa thams cad 'joms// dpa' bo chen po dpa' mtshan stag lpags can// log 'dren srin po'i mtha' gnon dgra 'dul ba// rig pa'i rgyal po khro bo bzhugs so 'tshal// log 'dren 'dul ba'i slad du spyan 'dren na// 'gro ba'i don phyir mchod kyi gshegs su gsol// oṃ ma hā kro dha rā dza sa pā ri wā ra e h+ya hi/ pad+ma ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ/ ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai we d+yāṃ/ shab+da āḥhūm̐/ zhes mchod/ hūm̐/ chos nyid stong pa gnyis med ngang nyid las// 'jig rten spyod pa'i tshul yang mi spong zhing*// thabs la mkhas pas 'jigs byed skur ston pa// khro chen 'bar ba'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod// ye shes zhi pa'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang*// sku yi cha lugs za byed rngams stabs can// gsung gi nga ro 'brug stong ldir ba'i sgras// ma lus dbang du sdud la phyag 'tshal bstod// lhag pa'i ye shes rol pa ston mdzad cing*// sdigs pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs phyag na bsnams// nyon mongs dug chen rtsad nas 'joms mdzad pa// sbrul sdug rgyan gyis brgyan la phyag 'tshal bstod// bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas// dpa' bo'i stangs stabs brkyang bskum tshul du bzhugs// nyi zla 'bar ba'i spyan gyi sdang mig gis// bgegs dpung bsregs par mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod// gtum chen dus mtha'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar// glog stong 'gyur 'dra'i khro gnyer mche ba gtsigs// rngams pa'i nga ro 'brug sgra stong bzhin sgrogs// khro rgyal bgegs tshogs 'dul la phyag 'tshal bstod// 'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra nges sgrogs shing*// bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms mdzad pa// dngos grub ma lus stsol ba'i lha// bgegs kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces brjod/

hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ gsang sngags dang rigs sngags kyi rgyal po khro bo rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dpal mgon dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis dmigs yul tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bgyi ba la gson gyi dus tshe gnas pa la bar du gcod par byed cing*/ gshin gyi dus na sdig pa sbyong ba la bar du gcod pa dang*/ slar yang gshin po de nyid kyi cha byad du bzung ste/ nye 'brel dang 'jig rten pa gzhan bslu bar byed pa'i gdon bgegs log par 'dren pa'i tshogs gang yin pa de dag thams cad la rgyud sde dang mthun pa'i sbyang ba rnam par dag pa byas zin pa des tshim par gyis la sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig gang dag mi 'gro ba de dag la dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi khro bo'i rdo rje 'bar zhing rab tu 'bar ba 'dis khyed rnams kyi mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par bya'o// zhes dang*/ rol mo'i sgra drag po bya zhing*/ gu gul gyis bdugs/ yungs kar gyis brabs pa ni drag po'i sbyang ba ste/ de'i rgyu mtshan yod de sngags dang rdzas gnyis ka drag po yin pa'i phyir ro// de nas sdig pa bsregs pa'i phyir rten gyi mdun du til/ g.yas su me/ g.yon du chu bzhag tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bya ba khyed rang gi tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad snying gar yi ge kaṃ nag po'i rnam par gnas pa rlung gis gyen la bteg

sna bug nas thon/ sdig pa rwa can gyi rnam pa mdun gyi til la thim pa/ g.yas su ye shes kyi mes bsreg g.yon du rgya mtsho chen po'i chur dor ba'i mos pa mdzod/ byas la/ mchod g.yog pas til mtheb srin gyis blangs la/ lag pa g.yas pas g.yas su bskor/ g.yon pas g.yon du bskor/ gnyis kas mdun du bskor te/ me dang chu nang du blug de nas me de chur bcug phyir 'phang ngo*// 'di la kha cig skabs 'dir rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sbyin sreg byed pa dang*/ 'ga' zhig til la sdig pa'i gzugs byed pa sogs 'dug mod/ dang po ni 'dir ma 'brel zhing*/ phyi ma ni de ltar byed pa gzhan du bshad kyang 'dir mi dgos te tshig gi nus pas shes par nus so// de nas phyir bzlog bya ba ni/ gtsug dgu'i rgyud las/ yungs kar yi ge bya ba yi// yungs kar me tog dang ldan pas// sngags rnams bzlos shing rdeg par bya// zhes dang*/ las kyi sgrib pa 'joms pa'i rgyud las/ sa'am/ til lam/ yungs kar ram/ chu gang yang rung ba la bzlas brjod byas te/ rus pa'am shi ba'i lus la gtor ram khrus byas na de ngan song du skyes pa yang zhag bdun gyis gdon mi za bar thar te/ mtho ris su skye bar 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs pas/ kaṃ ka ni dang*/ durga dang*/ yig brgya dang*/ oṃ gsum ma sogs gzungs sngags byin brlabs can mang du bzlas pa'i nus pa bye ma'am/ yungs kar la bstim/ de rten la brabs shing*/ oṃ da ha da ha sarba na ra ga ti he tu na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ pa tsa pa tsa sarba pre ta ga ti he tu na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma thā ma thā sarba tir+ya ga te he tu na hūm̐ phaṭa/ tshe 'das kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad dag par gyur cig ces brjod cing*/ sngags de rnams lan gsum brjod pa phyi ma mdzad do// de nas khrus bya ba la mchod g.yog pas sku phyis phrag pa g.yon du bkal/ g.yon me long dang g.yas bum pa 'dzin pas thog mar dkyil 'khor la me long bstan te/

ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ me long la bum chu blug rgyal ba'i sku la nyon mongs mi mnga' yang*// sems can lus kyi sgrib pa sbyong slad du// rgyal ba'i sku la khrus chab 'di gsol bas// sems can lus kyi sgrib pa dag gyur cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ rgyal ba'i gsung la 'gag pa mi mnga' yang*// sems can ngag gi sgrib pa sbyong slad du// rgyal ba'i gsung la khrus chab 'di gsol bas// sems can ngag gi sgrib pa dag gyur cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ rgyal ba'i thugs la 'khrul pa mi mnga' yang*// sems can yid kyi sgrib pa sbyong slad du// rgyal ba'i thugs la khrus chab 'di gsol bas// sems can yid kyi sgrib pa dag gyur cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ spyod 'jug las/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang de sras la// rin chen bum pa mang po spos kyi chu// yid 'ong legs par bkang ba'i glu dang ni// rol mo bcas pa du mas sku khrus gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos// gtsang la dri rab bgos pas sku phyi'o// oṃ hūm̐ tram̐ hrīḥ.āḥka ya bi shwo dha nī ye swā hā/ zhes me long la sku gzugs shar ba'i rdul rnams phyis par bsam/ de nas chu de bum par blug de nas ku shas rten la chu gtor zhing*/ mar me mdzad kyi phyag rgya gzhung las bshad/ 'di ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin chu// ser sna'i dri ma sbyong mdzad pa// gtong ba dri yis legs bsgos chu// khrus legs mdzad kyis sku khrus gsol// oṃ gsum bzla zhing rol mo dang bcas pas 'khru/

de bzhin du/ 'di ni tshul khrims rang bzhin chu// khrims 'chal dri ma sbyong mdzad pa// tshul khrims dri yis legs bsgos chu// khrus legs mdzad kyis sku khrus gsol// 'di ni bzod pa'i rang bzhin chu// khong khro'i dri ma sbyong mdzad pa// bzod pa dri yis legs bsgos chu// khrus legs mdzad kyis sku khrus gsol// 'di ni brtson 'grus rang bzhin chu// le lo'i dri ma sbyong mdzad pa// brtson 'grus dri yis legs bsgos chu// khrus legs mdzad kyis sku khrus gsol// 'di ni bsam gtan rang bzhin chu// rnam g.yeng dri ma sbyong mdzad pa// bsam gtan dri yis legs bsgos chu// khrus legs mdzad kyis sku khrus gsol// 'di ni shes rab rang bzhin chu// shes 'chal dri ma sbyong mdzad pa// shes rab dri yis legs bsgos chu// khrus legs mdzad kyis sku khrus gsol// rin chen 'bar ba las/ chu bo drug gi khrus byas pas// bag chags rnam drug sbyangs nas ni// gang la nyes pa mi mnga' zhing*// khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo// dri chu drug gi khrus byas pas// dri ma rnam drug sbyangs mdzad pa// rgya chen yon tan drug ldan pa// khrus legs mdzad la nyes mi mnga'// dri ma rnam drug dag pa yi// yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa// sangs rgyas thams cad mchod don du// dad pas bdag gis khrus bgyi 'o// zhes sngags dang bcas pas 'khru/ de nas/ tshe 'das che ge mo zhes bgyi bar pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad dag nas pha rol phyin pa'i yon tan phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan zhing myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig ces bkru/ de nas/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum// 'di dag 'jig rten dug gsum ste// bcom ldan sangs rgyas dug mi mnga'// sangs rgyas bden pas dug bcom mo// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum// 'di dag 'jig rten dug gsum ste// bcom ldan dam chos dug mi mnga'// dam chos bden pas dug bcom mo// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum// 'di dag 'jig rten dug gsum ste// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun dug mi mnga'// dge 'dun bden pas dug bcom mo// zhes sh+lau ka re re'i mtshams su gzungs dang khrus bya/

dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum gyi bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ tshe las 'das pa che ge mo nyon mongs pa dug gsum gyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa sbyangs nas dge ba gsum dang ldan par gyur cig ces bden stobs brjod pas bkru'o// rma bya chen mo las/ sa 'di dug gi pha yin te// sa 'di dug gi ma yang yin// bden pa'i bden tshig 'di dag gis// dug gsum sa yi nang du song*// chu 'di dug gi pha yin te// chu 'di dug gi ma yang yin// bden pa'i bden tshig 'di dag gis// dug gsum chu yi nang du song*// me 'di dug gi pha yin te// me 'di dug gi ma yang yin// bden pa'i bden tshig 'di dag gis// dug gsum me yi nang du song*// rlung 'di dug gi pha yin te// rlung 'di dug gi ma yang yin// bden pa'i bden tshig 'di dag gis// dug gsum rlung gi nang du song*// zhes tshigs bcad re re'i mtshams su dril gsil dang bcas khrus bya/ tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bya ba 'byung ba bzhi la brten nas bskyed pa'i nyon mongs pa'i sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa sbyangs te 'byung ba chos nyid kyi ngang du thim nas sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa thams cad dang bral bar gyur cig ces brjod/ 'di la kha cig sa chu me rlung sogs khyer nas rten la phyogs pa'i tshul byed pa lugs gzhan dang 'dres pa yin gyi/ rang lugs bum chu 'thor ba kho nas chog pa dpal ldan bsod nams rtse mo'i bde mchog gi dus mtha' dang*/ rje btsun rin po che'i gsung rab las rgyas par bshad pas 'di kho na ltar bya'o// de nas mchod g.yogs pas rten la bum chu 'thor zhing*/ gzhan rnams sh+lau ka re'i mtshams su dril bu gsil zhing me tog 'thor ba dang bcas/ gang la ser sna rnams chags pa// rnam bcom dri ma med mdzad pa// thugs zhi gnod pa mi mnga' des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par gyur// 'dren pa gang zhig 'gro ba rnams// thar pa'i lam du 'dzud mdzad cing*// chos rnams thams cad ston pa des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par gyur// ston pa 'gro ba rnams kyi rten// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// gang la bde legs mdzad pa des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par gyur// skyob pa gang zhig byams pa yis// thugs kyi 'gro ba 'di dag kun// bu gcig bzhin du rtag bskyangs shing*// khyed la bde legs mdzad par gyur// gang zhig 'khor bar 'gro ba yi// sems can kun gyi rten gyur cing*// gling dang dpung gnyen gyur pa des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par gyur// gang zhig chos kun mngon sum du// gtsang zhing bkru ba mi mnga' yang*// gsum gtsang gtsang mar mdzad pa des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par gyur// dpa' bo chen po gang skyes pa// phun sum tshogs don gang 'byor zhing*// don grub tshogs kyang grub pa des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par gyur// gang zhig skyes pa'i sa rnams ni// nags tshal bcas pa rab g.yo zhing*// sems can thams cad rab dga' des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par gyur// byang chub snying por gshegs pa na// sa dag rnam drug g.yos gyur cing*// bdud yid mi bder gyur pa des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par gyur// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba na// 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams gsungs shing*// thub pa'i bsnyen pa gang byung des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par gyur// yig 'phrog gang zhig mu stegs byed// thams cad chos kyi pham mdzad cing*// tshogs kun dbang du mdzad pa des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par gyur// sangs rgyas khyed la bde legs mdzad// brgya byin tshangs pa'i lha rnams dang*// 'byung po kun gyi bde legs de// khyed la rtag tu sbyin gyur cig

/sangs rgyas bsod nams mthu dag dang*// lha rnams kun gyi bsam pa dang*// khyed kyi 'dod don gang yin pa// don de de ring 'grub gyur cig /rkang gnyis khyed cag bde legs shog /rkang bzhi khyed cag bde legs shog /khyed cag lam du bde legs shog /phyir 'ongs dag kyang bde legs shog /nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs// nyi ma'i gung la bde legs shing*// khyed cag kun tu bde legs gyur// khyed cag sdig par ma gyur cig /tshe las 'das pa che ge mos thog drangs pa'i skye dgu thams cad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rgyal nas shin tu bkra shis par gyur cig ces brjod/ de nas slob dpon gyis/ 'o 'jig rten 'di nas 'jig rten pha rol tu tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bya ba khyed rang gi tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad stobs bzhi tshang ba'i sgo nas bshags pa bya dgos pas/ de'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin gyis/ khyed rang gi mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas 'di nyid du bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la mkha' spyod kyi dpa' bo dang*/ rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mngon sum lta bur bzhugs pa ni rten gyi stobs so// de dag gi spyan sngar khyed rang gi pha mas gtsor byas pa'i sems can thams cad 'khod de sngar byas kyi sdig pa la 'gyod sems drag po skyes pa ni rnam par sun 'byin pa'i stobs/ phyin chad srog la babs kyang sdig pa'i las nam yang mi bgyid snyam pa ni gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs/ de ltar du bgyis pas sdig sgrib ji ltar che yang 'dag nges snyam pa nyams pa sor chud pa'i stobs te/ stobs bzhi tshang pa'i sgo nas tshul bzhin du bshags par bgyi'o// snyam pa'i sgo nas lus gus pa'i sgo nas thal mo sbyar/ ngag gus pa'i sgo nas phyag 'tshal dang*/ skyabs 'gro'i rjes zlos gyis/ yid gus pa'i sgo nas dad mos kyi shugs drag po dang ldan pa'i sgo nas phyag 'tshal ba'i mos pa gyis/

zhes brjod/ bu la sogs pa'i nye du yod na ming byang bzung la phyag byed du bcug la/ legs grub kyi rgyud las/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ngo bo nyid// dkon mchog gsum gyi rtsa ba ste// bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// mgon po thugs rje che ldan pa// thams cad mkhyen pa'i ston pa po// bsod nams yon tan rgya mtsho'i zhing*// de bzhin gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo// dag pas 'dod chags bral ba'i rgyu// dge bas ngan song las grol zhing*// gcig tu don dam mchog gyur pa// zhi gyur chos la phyag 'tshal lo// grol nas grol ba'i lam yang ston// bslab pa dag la rab tu gnas// zhing gi dam pa yon gnas zhing*// dge 'dun la yang phyag 'tshal lo// dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// mkha' 'gro ma yis 'khor los sgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsum brnyes// 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo// 'jam dbyangs phyag na rdo rje spyan ras gzigs// sa yi snying po sgrib pa rnam par sel// nam mkha'i snying po byams pa kun tu bzang*// nye ba'i sras chen brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo// phyag byar 'os pa thams cad la// zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyi// lus btud pa yis rnam kun tu// mchog tu dad pas phyag 'tshal lo// zhes dang*/ zhi ba lhas mdzad pa/ gtso bo rgyal ba 'gro ba'i mgon// 'gro ba skyob pa'i don brtson pa// stobs chen 'jigs pa kun sel ba// tshe 'das skyabs su mchi lags so// de yi thugs su chud pa'i chos// 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa sel mdzad pa// byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs la yang*// de bzhin tshe 'das skyabs su mchi// tshe 'das 'jigs pa che mthong nas// kun tu bzang la tshe 'das phul// 'jam dpal dbyangs la tshe 'das kyi// lus 'di bdag gis dbul bar bgyi// thugs rje'i spyod pa ma 'khrul ba'i// spyan ras gzigs mgon de la yang*// nyam thag nga ros 'o dod 'bod// sdig ldan 'di la skyab tu gsol// 'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po dang*// sa yi snying po dag dang ni// thugs rje'i bdag nyid thams cad la// phyag 'tshal snying nas 'o dod 'bod// gang zhig mthong na gshin rje yi// pho nya la sogs sdang ba rnams// skrag nas phyogs bcur 'gyer byed pa// rdo rje can la skyabs su mchi// sngon chad khyed kyi bka' las 'das// da ni 'jigs pa cher mthong nas// khyed la skyabs su mchi lags kyi// 'jigs pa myur du bsal du gsol// tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bya ba dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar du/

dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum/ mkha' spyod rdo rje rnal 'byor ma byang chub sems dpa' nye ba'i sras brgyad dang bcas pa rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// sdig pa thams cad sbyang du gsol/ lam bstan du gsol/ myur du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par mdzad du gsol/ zhes snying thag pa nas brjod cing gsol ba 'debs par bsam/ de nas slob dpon gyis/ khyed rang thams cad skad cig gis sangs rgyas rdo rje chos sku mdog dmar po rdo rje dril bu thugs kar bsnol nas 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i sku can gsal ba la mchod bstod bgyis pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod/ oṃ badz+ra dharmā sa pā ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ de bzhin du mtshan sngags re re sbyar ba'i/ puṣ+pe nas/ shab+da'i bar/ 'dod chags rdo rje chos kyi sku// kun rtog ye shes rdo rje'i sku// ting 'dzin chen po'i phyag rgya can// phyag 'tshal snang ba mtha' yas la// zhes bstod/ de nas tshogs la sogs pa chab kyis bran la/ oṃ sum+bha ni sogs kyis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las 'dod yon kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par bsams/ a ka ro lan gsum dang*/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi sho mu khe bh+yaḥsogs lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ gdangs dang bcas/ kha dog dbyibs legs yid 'ong rgyan phreng ldan// phyogs dus kun na gzugs mchog ci mchis rnams// rnam shes rten gyi lha la bdag 'bul na// bzhes shing tshe 'das byang chub thob par shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta rū pa ka ma gu ṇa pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ zhes me long phul/ de bzhin/ phyogs dus kun na zin dang ma zin pa'i// yon tan tshig mchog sgra snyan ci mchis rnams// rnam shes rten gyi lha la bdag 'bul na// bzhes shing tshe 'das byang chub thob par shog

/shab+da ka ma gu ṇa pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ rol mo 'bul/ phyogs dus kun na tsan+dan sbrul snying dang*// a dkar nag sogs dbang po tshim byed rnams// rnam shes rten gyi lha la bdag 'bul na// bzhes shing tshe 'das byang chub thob par shog /gan+dhe ka ma gu na pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ dri bzang gi bdud rtsi 'bul/ phyogs dus kun na ro dang bcud ldan pa'i// lus sems rtas byed ro mchog ci mchis rnams// rnam shes rten gyi lha la bdag 'bul na// bzhes shing tshe 'das byang chub thob par shog /ra sa ka ma gu ṇa pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ tshogs phud 'bul/ phyogs dus kun na 'jam mnyen 'khril chags pa'i// reg bya'i khyad par lus sems tshim byed rnams// rnam shes rten gyi lha la bdag 'bul na// bzhes shing tshe 'das byang chub thob par shog /spar+she ka ma gu ṇa/ zhes na bza' phul/ tshe 'das la/ mig gi yul du gzugs mdzes pa/ rna ba'i yul du sgra snyan pa/ sna'i yul du dri zhim pa/ lce'i yul du ro mngar ba/ lus kyi yul du reg bya 'jam pa la sogs pa 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga la zhen chags med pa'i sgo nas longs spyod par gyur/ ces brjod/ de nas slob dpon gyi mdun du mar me sbar ba zhig bzhag byang bu slob dpon gyi phyag tu 'phul/ gsung dpangs mtho ba dang bcas/ 'o/ tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bgyi ba khyod nyon cig 'di ltar gzugs la sogs par snang ba'i chos thams cad dang*/ bdag gzhan gyi tshor ba bde sdug 'du shes la sogs pa thams cad rmi lam sgyu ma lta bur rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa la bden par bzung ste don la med bzhin du 'khrul snang gi sdug bsngal bsam gyis mi khyab pa myong dgos pa'i sems can rnams la snying rje dung pa re bsgom/ stong nyid snying rje zung du 'brel ba'i sgo nas khyed rang gi tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib da lta bar do'i 'khrul snang*/ phyi ma ngan song gsum du skye 'gyur gyi las ngan ji snyed yod pa thams cad blos phyogs gcig tu bsdoms te bsreg bya bud shing gi rnam par gyur/

skyabs gnas bslu ba med pa dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum gyi thugs rje dang*/ byin brlabs dang*/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i cho ga rnam par dag pa'i nus mthu dang*/ nye du 'brel ba shul nas mchis pa rnams kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba bgyis dang bgyi 'gyur bgyid bzhin pa thams cad dang*/ khyed rang gi shes rgyud kyi steng na yod pa'i dge rtsa ji snyed yod pa thams cad blos phyogs gcig tu bsdus nas ye shes kyi me'i rnam par gyur/ me de nyid kyis bsreg bya sdig pa'i bud shing sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa thams cad bsreg bya dang sreg byed dang bral ba'i tshul gyis bsreg pas/ khyed rang gi rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo skye ba med pa'i rdo rje chos su gnas pa de nyid 'di nas skar mda' 'phangs pa bzhin du mkha' la spyod pa'i zhing khams su rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i zhabs 'bring du 'khod/ der yang gsal stong 'dzin pa ma mchis pa'i ngang du mnyam par 'jog pa zhu/ zhes brda sprad/ dpon slob rnams kyis dril gsil gdangs dang bcas pas/ rgya gar gyi slob dpon rig 'dzin rdo rje chos kyis gsang ba 'dus pa'i dus mtha'i cho gar bshad pa'i/ stong nyid ye shes 'bar ba'i mer// tshe 'das sgrib pa'i bud shing 'di// 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal ma lus pa// ye shes snang ba 'bar gyur cig /ces lan gsum brjod pa'i dang po gnyis kyi rjes su byang bu me la yu mer dang*/ gsum pa'i dus me sbar/ oṃ gsum ma brjod cing rol mo bya/ dmigs yul de nyid cho ga byed po rang nyid dang ji ltar sbyangs pa'i tshul dang gsum rang sems las logs su gyur pa cung zad kyang med pas sems snang tsam dang*/ sems de yang gsal stong 'dzin med kyi ngang du bzhag shes rab lta bas rgyas 'debs pa gal che/ slob dpon gyis byang ro legs par btags dmar gdags thal ba de 'jim pa dang bsres sāts+tsha 'debs/ de nas lam sbyangs bstan bya ba ni/

slob dpon gyis dril gsil me tog 'thor zhing*/ gdangs dang bcas pas/ gtsug dgu'i rgyud las/ dkon mchog rin chen dpal bzhin du// dkon mchog rin chen las byung ba'i// dkon mchog rin chen 'od zer gyis// rin chen phreng ba rnam dag pa// tshogs kyi lam dang sbyor ba'i lam// mthong ba'i lam dang sgom pa'i lam// bla na med pa'i khyad par lam// byang chub bar chad med pa'i lam// rnam par grol ba'i lam dag la// rten nas sdig pa kun sbyangs te// 'phags pa'i lam der 'gro bar shog /sbyong rgyud las/ oṃ rat+na rat+ne/ ma hā rat+ne/ ret+na ki rat+ne/ rat+na ma ma bi shud+dhe sarba pā paṃ hūm̐ tra thā/ zhes brjod cing rol mo bya/ pad+ma 'dam gyis ma gos ltar// srid gsum dri mas ma gos shing*// srid pa'i pad+mo las byung ba'i// mkha' spyod zhing du skye bar shog /oṃ pad+me pad+me pad+ma saṃ bha we ma hā su ṣa gats+tshan+tu swā hā/ zhes brjod cing rol mo bya ste mkha' spyod du skye bar bsam/ slob dpon gyis/ der skyes pa'i byang sems rnying pa rnams kyis kyang*/ phyis kyi de la mchod par gyur par bsams la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ/ nas/ shab+da'i bar brjod cing rol mo bya/ des kyang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma 'khor dang bcas pa la mchod par bsam la mchod cing rol mo bya/ der skyes pa'i rgyu brtags pas rdo rje slob dpon 'khor bcas kyi cho ga'i nus pa yin par shes te/ rdzu 'phrul gyis 'dir 'ongs nas bdag dang dkyil 'khor pa rnams la mchod par bsams la sngar ltar mchod cing rol mo bya/ sbyong rgyud las/ e ma sangs rgyas e sangs rgyas// e ma sangs rgyas mdzad pa legs// gang phyir ngan song bdag cag sbyangs// byang chub spyod pa nyid la bkod// ces ched du mchod par bsams/ bdag gis kyang slar de la mchod par gyur par bsams la sngar bzhin rol mo bya zhing*/ slar mkha' spyod du song bar gyur par bsam zhing me tog gtor/

de nas skabs 'dir bsngo ba bya zhing smon lam rgyas par bya'o// rjes chog ni dkyil chog ltar bya'o// ༈ /de ltar mkha' spyod rdo rje rnal 'byor mar// brten nas dmigs yul thar pa bgrod pa'i thabs// lho sgo'i cho ga ji ltar bris pa'i dges// 'gro kun thar lam bgrod pa'i rgyur gyur cig /bdag blo dman zhing sbyangs pa chung ba'i phyir// mkhas pa dgyes pa'i legs bshad ma mchis mod// bdag dang bdag 'dra'i blo dman 'ga' zhig la// phan par srid snyam the tshom med par bris// de ltar na yang gong ma'i gsung rab dang*// drin can bla ma'i phyag bzhes 'khrul mo deb// rang bzo spangs te legs par bkod pa'i dges// skul ba po yis bzhed dgongs mthar phyin shog /ces pa 'di yang pha bla ma mkhyen rab rdo rje 'chang chen po'i bka' 'bangs kyi tha chung lhun grub kyis bgrang gzhi bcu phrag bdun du slebs pa/ mdzes byed kyi lo rgyal zla ba'i dkar phyogs dge bar dben gnas rmor dgon par sgrigs pa'i yi ge pa ni shing dgon pa bka' bcu kun bsam gyis bgyis pa 'dis kyang lus can ma lus thar lam bgrod pa'i rgyur gyur cig /maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
